t: This comprehensive assortment of fibre and rubber washers provides essential sealing solutions for plumbing installations. Ideal for plumbers and general maintenance professionals, this kit supports various repair and installation tasks. The 210-piece set includes a wide range of sizes and types, such as ½" fibre washers, stopcock washers, and ball valve seat washers, ensuring compatibility with common tap and valve systems. It also features rubber bottle trap washers, cap and lining washers, shower flex washers, and washing machine hose washers for diverse applications. Compression olives are also included for secure pipe connections. This versatile collection ensures tradespeople have the right component for reliable, leak-free plumbing work.
